verdict.summary: Spotify content cannot be put into an AI model. An agent may use Spotify data only transiently for user-authorized execution or display, without putting that content into the model. Wider distribution requires Partner Application approval and then Extended Quota review. The organization must meet more than the 250,000 monthly-active-user requirement. It must also be legally registered, have a launched service, use a company email, be available in key Spotify markets, show commercial viability, and follow Spotify's Terms.
verdict.activeEffort: 2–5 days, mostly compliance evidence and a reviewer demo, once eligible
verdict.waitTime: Up to 6 weeks for quota-extension review after Partner Application approval. No official Partner Application timeline was found.
verdict.mainGate: Extended Quota Mode requires an approved Partner Application. Applicants must be legally registered organizations with a company email, an active launched service, at least 250,000 monthly active users, availability in key Spotify markets, commercial viability, and Terms compliance. Spotify also reserves extended access for established, scalable, impactful use cases that support artist and creator discovery.

sources.quote:
The expires_in value returned by the Spotify token endpoint
( POST https://accounts.spotify.com/api/token ) is the lifetime of the access
token, not the refresh token.

To refresh an access token, we must send a POST request with the following
parameters:

grant_type Required Set it to refresh_token . 
refresh_token Required The refresh token returned from the authorization token request.

Authorization Only required for the Authorization Code Base 64 encoded string that contains the client ID and client secret key. The field must have the format: Authorization: Basic <base64 encoded client_id:client_secret>
